name: export-design
description:
Export an existing Canva design as a downloadable file to save and use outside Canva.

Use when a selected design needs to be printed, attached to an email, sent or shared as a file outside Canva, converted to another file type, or downloaded as selected pages.

Only call after you have confirmed that the selected design supports the requested format. Returns a download URL for the exported file.

design_id.description: ID of the existing Canva design to export. Design IDs start with "D".

format.description: Export settings for the downloadable file.

as_single_image.description: Optional PNG setting. True merges a multi-page design into one image.

export_quality.description: Optional export quality for PDF, PNG, JPG, GIF, PPTX, or MP4.

height.description: Optional output height in pixels for PNG, JPG, or GIF exports.

lossless.description: Optional PNG compression setting. True uses lossless compression; defaults to true.

pages.description: Page numbers to export (1-based). Draw these from the pages "get-export-formats" reported as available for this "type" on this design; when it reported no specific pages for this "type", any page is valid. Omit this field to export every page.

anyOf.description: Use for types: jpg. Image quality from 1-100
Required for types: mp4. Video quality (e.g., 'horizontal_1080p')

size.description: Optional paper size for PDF exports.

transparent_background.description: Optional PNG background setting. True exports a transparent background; defaults to false.

type.description: Format to export as. Use only a format that "get-export-formats" reported as supported for this design.

width.description: Optional output width in pixels for PNG, JPG, or GIF exports.

user_intent.description: Mandatory description of what the user is trying to accomplish with this tool call. This should always be provided by LLM clients. Please keep it concise (255 characters or less recommended).
